recovery_steps: check nginx process and port 80/443
check php-fpm process
verify WordPress API GET health endpoint
check GitHub HTTPS and DNS reachability
verify Slack webhook DNS and TLS
confirm cron is active and lock files are cleared
review exchange/logs for any FAIL entries
scan exchange/locks for lock files older than threshold
verify no live process holds the lock
prepare manual removal command (do not execute in dry-run)
document lock cleanup in evidence log
check .env file presence in project root
verify required env keys are present (without printing values)
confirm systemd or cron env injection is configured
run dry-run check of credential readiness
run HEAD request to WordPress REST API endpoint
check HTTP status code is 2xx or 4xx (not 5xx or timeout)
verify authentication headers load correctly
confirm no draft posts were created during reconnect
check github.com DNS resolution
run git ls-remote read-only probe
verify no push or merge was triggered
confirm SSH key presence without exposing key content
